description: List the org's invoices, newest first. Each invoice has a url where the payer views and pays it.

statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses to include: paid, unpaid, void. Omit to return every invoice except void ones.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: invoices_list
